author: "Emma Caetano"

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(rvest)

war_data <- read_csv("pennant-war-2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

team_ba_pages <- paste0(
  "https://www.ncaa.com/stats/softball/d1/current/team/281",
  c("", "/p2", "/p3", "/p4", "/p5", "/p6", "/p7")
)

team_ba <- map_dfr(team_ba_pages, function(page_url) {
  page <- read_html(page_url)
  table <- page %>% html_node("table") %>% html_table(fill = TRUE)

  if (is.null(table)) return(tibble())

  table %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    select(Team = 2, BA = 5) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(Team, "Team"), !is.na(Team)) %>%
    mutate(
      Team = str_replace(Team, "\\s+", " ") %>% str_trim(),
      BA = as.numeric(str_replace(BA, "^\\.", "0.")) / 1000
    )
}) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(desc(BA)) %>%
  rename(team = Team, ba = BA)

team_era_pages <- paste0(
  "https://www.ncaa.com/stats/softball/d1/current/team/282",
  c("", "/p2", "/p3", "/p4", "/p5", "/p6", "/p7")
)

team_era <- map_dfr(team_era_pages, function(page_url) {
  page <- read_html(page_url)
  table <- page %>% html_node("table") %>% html_table(fill = TRUE)

  if (is.null(table)) return(tibble())

  table %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    select(Team = 2, ER = 6) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(Team, "Team"), !is.na(Team)) %>%
    mutate(
      Team = str_replace(Team, "\\s+", " ") %>% str_trim(),
      ER = as.numeric(ER)
    )
}) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(desc(ER)) %>%
  rename(team = Team, earned_runs = ER)

war_data <- war_data %>%
  left_join(team_ba, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(team_era, by = "team")

team_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(war_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

Batting average and batting WAR are related, but they do not measure the exact same thing. Batting average tells us how often a hitter gets a hit, while batting WAR captures a broader picture of how much a player contributes to run creation and overall team success. In general, players with higher batting averages often have stronger offensive production, but a player can still produce a high batting WAR by drawing walks, hitting for power, or creating runs in ways that do not always show up in a simple average.

ERA and pitching WAR are also related but not identical. ERA measures the average number of earned runs a pitcher allows per seven innings, so it focuses on run prevention in a very direct way. Pitching WAR, by contrast, estimates the total number of wins a pitcher adds above a replacement-level pitcher across all aspects of performance, including how often they miss bats, limit baserunners, and help their team win games.

<div class="team-search-box">
  <label for="team-search">Search for a team</label>
  <input id="team-search" type="text" placeholder="Type a team name..." />
</div>

<div class="team-search-box">
  <label for="team-select">Or choose a team</label>
  <select id="team-select">
    <option value="">Select a team</option>
  </select>
</div>

<div id="team-result" class="team-result">
  <p>Type a team name or choose one from the list to see its WAR and batting average.</p>
</div>

<script>
  const teamData = `r team_json`;

  const teamInput = document.getElementById("team-search");
  const teamSelect = document.getElementById("team-select");
  const teamResult = document.getElementById("team-result");

  teamData.forEach(team => {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = team.team;
    option.textContent = team.team;
    teamSelect.appendChild(option);
  });

  function buildTeamLogoUrl(teamName) {
    const slug = teamName
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/&/g, "and")
      .replace(/\./g, "")
      .replace(/[()]/g, "")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

    return `https://www.ncaa.com/sites/default/files/images/logos/schools/bgl/${slug}.svg`;
  }

  function renderTeam(team) {
    if (!team) {
      teamResult.innerHTML = "<p>Type a team name or choose one from the list to see its WAR and batting average.</p>";
      return;
    }

    const battingAverage = team.ba != null ? Number(team.ba).toFixed(3) : "N/A";
    const earnedRuns = team.earned_runs != null ? Number(team.earned_runs).toFixed(0) : "N/A";
    const logoUrl = buildTeamLogoUrl(team.team);

    teamResult.innerHTML = `
      <div class="team-card-header">
        <img src="${logoUrl}" alt="${team.team} logo" class="team-logo" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='inline-block';" />
        <span class="team-logo-fallback" style="display:none;">${team.team}</span>
        <h3>${team.team}</h3>
      </div>
      <p><strong>Conference:</strong> ${team.conference}</p>
      <p><strong>WAR Total:</strong> ${Number(team.war_total).toFixed(2)}</p>
      <p><strong>Batting WAR:</strong> ${Number(team.war_bat).toFixed(2)}</p>
      <p><strong>Pitching WAR:</strong> ${Number(team.war_pit).toFixed(2)}</p>
      <p><strong>Batting Average:</strong> ${battingAverage}</p>
      <p><strong>Earned Runs:</strong> ${earnedRuns}</p>
    `;
  }

  function findTeam(query) {
    const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalized) return null;

    return teamData.find(team =>
      team.team.toLowerCase().includes(normalized)
    ) || null;
  }

  teamInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
    const match = findTeam(this.value);
    if (match) {
      teamSelect.value = match.team;
    } else {
      teamSelect.value = "";
    }
    renderTeam(match);
  });

  teamSelect.addEventListener("change", function () {
    const selected = this.value;
    if (!selected) {
      teamInput.value = "";
      renderTeam(null);
      return;
    }

    const match = teamData.find(team => team.team === selected);
    teamInput.value = selected;
    renderTeam(match);
  });
</script>

  .team-search-box {
    margin: 1.5rem 0 1rem 0;

  }

  .team-search-box label {

  }

  }

  .team-card-header {
    display: flex;

  }

  .team-logo {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    object-fit: contain;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.2rem;
  }

  .team-logo-fallback {
    display: none;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1f2937;
  }
</style>
